description: This receiver runs a TCP server that accepts events via the [Fluent Forward protocol](https://github.com/fluent/fluentd/wiki/Forward-Protocol-Specification-v1).
name: fluentforwardreceiver

fluent_closed_connections.description: Number of connections closed to the fluentforward receiver

fluent_events_parsed.description: Number of Fluent events parsed successfully

fluent_opened_connections.description: Number of connections opened to the fluentforward receiver

fluent_parse_failures.description: Number of times Fluent messages failed to be decoded

fluent_records_generated.description: Number of log records generated from Fluent forward input
